description.zh: 任务节点ID，可调用[GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task node. You can call the [GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~) operation to query the node ID.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> :To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~).

description.zh: 节点变量，时间变量配置。取值类型为JSON格式的字符串。
description.en: The time variables configured for the node. The value of this parameter must be a JSON string.
